maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is tuition for new degree enrollments at Strayer and Capella, not servicing or replacing installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Tuition comes mainly from students, employers' tuition assistance and federal student aid; it is mostly private-pay, with Title IV a share.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes from enrollments and employer partnerships at Strayer and Capella, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Students and employers can choose other universities or benefit providers; switching mid-degree costs credits but isn't operationally critical.

notes: Larger part is U.S. Higher Education (Strayer, Capella); other parts are Education Technology Services and Australia/New Zealand. Federal student aid share is uncertain.
